title: Luxury 3BR/4BA in Nashville and close to Airport
description:
Discover comfort and style at Music City Retreat, a modern townhouse in Nashville’s heart! Relax in 3 spacious bedrooms with an open-concept living area, perfect for families or groups. Enjoy free parking, fast WiFi, and a peaceful stay just minutes from the airport and downtown. Ideal base to explore Music City.

Nashville Shores Lakeside Resort – 6 min
Andrew Jackson’s Hermitage – 7 min
Downtown Broadway – 12 min

We keep our home fresh, welcoming, and thoughtfully upgraded for every guest.
